components.name: Mechanical Key
components.description: The implemented pale numeric key with short mechanical travel.
components.css: .ds-key { min-height:58px; margin:0; border:1px solid #96988f; border-radius:8px; color:#202526; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f6f4ed,#e3e0d7); box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9) inset,0 4px 0 #777a73,0 7px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.3); font:650 20px/1 "DIN Alternate","Bahnschrift","Aptos",system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 70ms ease-out,box-shadow 70ms ease-out,filter 120ms ease-out; } .ds-key:hover { filter:brightness(1.04); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #74c7ff; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-key:active { transform:translateY(3px); box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.72) inset,0 1px 0 #6f726c,0 3px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.28); }

components.name: Cathode Display
components.description: The implemented recessed smoked aperture with expression, ghost segments, and phosphor result.
components.css: .ds-cathode-display { position:relative; min-height:128px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #050504; border-radius:9px; padding:21px 19px 17px; text-align:right; background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 5px,rgba(180,109,45,.035) 5px 6px),linear-gradient(180deg,#080806,#100f0c); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.055),0 5px 13px rgba(0,0,0,.82) inset; } .ds-cathode-display::before { content:"888888888888"; position:absolute; right:18px; bottom:16px; color:rgba(255,122,26,.1); font:500 clamp(38px,12vw,58px)/1 "SFMono-Regular","Cascadia Mono","Roboto Mono",ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:-.045em; white-space:nowrap; pointer-events:none; } .ds-cathode-expression { position:relative; z-index:1; min-height:21px; margin-bottom:9px; overflow:hidden; color:#c45a1f; font:500 14px/1.2 "SFMono-Regular","Cascadia Mono","Roboto Mono",ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.02em; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-cathode-result { position:relative; z-index:1; display:block; min-height:58px; overflow-x:auto; overflow-y:hidden; color:#ff9a43; font:500 clamp(38px,12vw,58px)/1 "SFMono-Regular","Cascadia Mono","Roboto Mono",ui-monospace,monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; letter-spacing:-.045em; text-shadow:0 2px 9px rgba(255,96,12,.62); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-cathode-display:focus-within { outline:3px solid #74c7ff; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
SC-01 is treated as a physical measurement instrument resting on a pale drafting bench, not as a generic dark calculator card. A graphite chassis, visible fasteners, engraved-feeling labels, and a smoked cathode aperture establish a professional, academic engineering character.

The visual hierarchy follows the working sequence of the instrument: identify the model and DEG state, read the warm phosphor result, reveal the scientific bank only when needed, then operate the tactile four-column keypad. The measurement grid and cathode glow are justified by that world; neither is free-floating decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Pale drafting bench with a measured grid.
Graphite enclosure with structural edge, inset, and fastener detail.
Smoked cathode aperture with a phosphor-orange numeric result.
Cool operator bank separated from pale mechanical keycaps.
Orange reserved for live instrument state and decisive calculation.

rules.name: The Rare Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange is reserved for the result, active instrument state, selection, and equals action; it must not become broad surface decoration.

rules.name: The Instrument Color Rule
rules.body: Every color must read as bench, chassis, aperture, key material, status, focus, or error—not as an unrelated brand flourish.

rules.name: The Data Face Rule
rules.body: Values, formulas, scientific keys, and model markings use the monospaced data stack; operational labels and primary keypad legends use the technical UI stack.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows must explain enclosure, recess, illumination, or mechanical travel; do not add floating-card elevation.

dos: Do preserve the continuous identity rail, recessed display, optional function bank, and four-column keypad hierarchy.
Do use orange only for functional energy: live result, active state, selection, and equals.
Do keep operator keys cool, numeric keys pale, and scientific keys graphite.
Do preserve visible focus, touch targets, keyboard parity, safe-area spacing, and the reduced-motion path.
Do let the measurement grid and cathode glow remain justified by the bench-instrument world.
donts: Don't return to the discarded yellow theme or turn the interface playful.
Don't use orange as a broad chassis, bench, or decorative background.
Don't replace mechanical key travel with flat generic buttons or floating-card motion.
Don't add ornamental effects that cannot be read as measurement, material, illumination, or operation.
Don't introduce external imagery, logos, testimonials, or commercial claims.
